subjects.description: A stone lighthouse on a rocky outcrop, lashed by rain and wind.
A dark, churning sea beneath the lighthouse, with wind-driven waves and whitecaps.
A weathered lighthouse keeper in heavy dark rain gear, moving with practiced urgency.
A narrow iron spiral staircase inside the lighthouse tower, with a handrail and rain-streaked windows.
The great lamp at the top of the lighthouse, with a metal wick mechanism and glass lens.
The focused amber beam thrown by the lighthouse lamp.

style: Cinematic realistic maritime drama, stormy night with deep blue-gray shadows, rain-lashed textures, warm amber lamp light contrasting the cold exterior, natural motion and atmospheric lighting.

summary.text: A lighthouse keeper battles a storm to climb the tower and light the lamp; the beam cuts through rain and darkness.

claims.text: A lighthouse keeper climbs the tower stairs in a storm and lights the lamp.
The lighthouse is a stone tower on a rocky outcrop with a glass lamp room.
The keeper wears heavy dark oilskins and carries a swinging lantern.
The tower has a narrow iron spiral stair and a glass lamp room with a metal wick mechanism.
Lightning, white surf, and rain-lashed windows heighten the storm.
A low restrained orchestral drone and slow heartbeat-like percussion underscore the storm.
